headline: White House Replaces US National Cyber Director After Major Tech Outages
summary: The US administration has ousted its national cyber director following intense scrutiny and political backlash over a wave of widespread technology outages across critical infrastructure.
why: The Office of the National Cyber Director advises the US President on cybersecurity policy and national digital infrastructure resilience.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Leadership changes at top cybersecurity offices follow major infrastructure disruptions.
